card.name: The word an before empty stomach
card.fires_on: The word "an" (occasionally "on") in dosing instructions such as "taken on an empty stomach", where the next word is expected to be "empty".

modes.label: on an

modes.description: The word "on" just before "an empty stomach" after a verb like taken.
modes.example: should be taken<< on>> an empty stomach with a glass of water

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "empty" next, as in "empty stomach".
card.plain: It fires when a label says to take a drug on an empty stomach, just before the word empty.
